title: As Xi Leaves Washington, Divisions Still Simmer Beneath the Surface
summary: President Trump welcomed Xi Jinping of China for a state visit that was heavy on pomp and ceremony. But surprisingly little time was spent on the issues that most divide the two superpowers.
